title: Marketing Executive
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Executive - Join a Growing, Creative, High-Impact Team
Location: Office-based 4 days per week (WFH Fridays)
Hours: Full-time, (finish at 2.30pm every Friday)
Salary: £35,000
Contract: Permanent

360 Campaigns - Newsletters - Social Media - Publication - Market - Lead Generation - Reports - Content Generation -

This is a busy, hands-on role for someone who enjoys a dynamic environment. From implementing and analysing 360 marketing campaigns - from newsletters and social media to SEO, PPC, and everything in between - you will be the go-to marketing professional for all things digital and print. You will also have the opportunity to coordinate both global and local events.

Do you have a good eye for social media? We're looking for a candidate who can create engaging posts that go beyond impressions and drive meaningful engagement with our audiences.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join our first UK-based marketing team in the heart of Northamptonshire. If you work in digital marketing and can support our Head of Marketing in creating and growing campaigns, this could be the perfect role for you!

About the Job

We attribute a large part of our growth to being found online by customers through marketing, and this continues to be a driving force behind our business. To help generate leads and support our future growth plans, we're now looking for a highly ambitious Marketing Executive to join us.

Key Parts of the Role

Content and graphic creation: Producing content and graphics that align with the brand across social media, websites, Google Ads, and more
- PPC experience

Keyword research: Conducting keyword research to identify relevant, high-traffic keywords across different markets, products, competitors, and audiences
Internet business analysis: Day-to-day, you will work across our international markets (UK, EU, and Rest of World excluding the USA), focusing on campaign planning optimisation, creation, and execution
Print marketing: Creating corporate designs for banners, flyers, display stands, and more
Performance measurement: Monitoring ROI, CTAs, gated content, traffic, and conversions
A/B testing: Conducting A/B tests to determine the most effective ad copy, keywords, and targeting strategies

What we're looking for in you
Our next Marketing Executive should already understand campaign-driven marketing strategy.
We're also open to either agency or in-house experience, but what's important is that you'll come with a passion for us and what you do. Digital Marketing is critical to gaining new customers and growing our brand globally.

About You:
Strong background and proven track record in marketing campaigns with an agency or in-house
- PPC

Multilingual ad campaigns
Strong analytical skills will be essential and have second-to-none communication skills and attention to detail.
Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop, InDesign, and Adobe Illustrator
Able to operate at both a strategic and tactical level with a blend of analytical, creative, and numerical skills
Be able to thrive in a data-driven environment
Excellent stakeholder management
Ability to work to deadlines, manage multiple projects and react quickly to changing business priorities

Essential Skills

Commercial Awareness: Presenting clear, data-backed business cases to improve efficiency & drive new customer acquisition
Growth: Contribute to achieving the acquisition, revenue, and customer LTV targets across key markets
Processes: Build and develop efficient processes and workflows
Branding: Ensure unified messaging and consistent branding across all marketing channels and communications
Communication: Confidently and clearly communicate your chosen search strategies, optimisation techniques and results to all stakeholders

Company Benefits:

Flexible working hours
Friday working from home
Annual leave 25 days plus bank holidays
Team trips to marketing conferences
Free fresh fruit and hot drinks
Company claims back scheme on various health services
Company pension scheme
Free Parking

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
Hybrid Full Time Permanent
About the Employer
An established UK technology business providing IT infrastructure, data protection, disaster recovery and enterprise technology solutions to organisations across a range of sectors. Working closely with leading global technology vendors, the company combines specialist technical expertise with long-standing industry experience to help customers protect, manage and modernise business-critical IT environments.
The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a hands-on Marketing Executive to join a growing B2 B technology marketing team. This practical, delivery-focused position will play an important role in turning marketing strategies into effective, measurable campaigns across digital channels.
Working closely with marketing, sales and SDR colleagues, you will build and manage campaigns in HubSpot, create landing pages and email sequences, develop marketing assets, support PPC and social media activity, and monitor campaign performance. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised marketer looking to develop their expertise in B2 B technology, campaign management and digital marketing.
Duties & Responsibilities
- Build and manage integrated marketing campaigns in HubSpot, including emails, landing pages, forms, lists, workflows and associated campaign assets.
- Maintain and organise the HubSpot portal to ensure campaigns, marketing assets, data and reporting remain accurate and consistent.
- Produce campaign reports and dashboards, monitoring marketing performance against agreed KPIs and objectives.
- Create professional landing pages, email campaigns and marketing resources in line with established brand and editorial guidelines.
- Plan, create and publish engaging social media content, particularly for LinkedIn, while supporting paid digital and PPC campaigns.
- Collaborate with marketing, SDR and sales teams to understand briefs and deliver both long-term campaigns and fast-turnaround marketing projects.
- Create and adapt visual marketing assets using Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud applications, while supporting website content development and management.
- Support channel and co-marketing campaigns with major technology vendors and strategic partners.

Education & Skills Required
- A degree in marketing or a related discipline, or an equivalent professional marketing qualification such as CIM, would be advantageous.
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within B2 B IT, technology or a channel environment such as a vendor, reseller, MSP or technology partner.
- Strong HubSpot skills covering campaign creation, management, automation, organisation, reporting and performance measurement.
- Experience creating professional landing pages, email campaigns, digital marketing content and associated campaign assets.
- Working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, combined with excellent written and spoken English and strong attention to detail.
- An organised, collaborative and dependable approach, with the ability to manage varied workloads, meet deadlines and communicate effectively with sales, SDR and marketing stakeholders. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
- Hybrid.
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:30pm.
- Banbury.
- Salary: 30 k to 35 k. (Depending on experience)
If you are an enthusiastic and detail-focused Marketing Executive looking to develop your career within the B2 B technology sector, this is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of meaningful campaigns and expand your digital marketing expertise. Apply today to take the next step in your marketing career.
For a discreet, detailed discussion about the role, you can reach out to Vanessa Rodriguez at (phone number removed) or email (url removed)

title: Social Media Assistant (Part Time)
description:
Social Media Assistant (Part Time)

Berzerk Active Play Trilogy Active
8 Hours per Week
SCP 24 (Pro Rata)

Help us inspire active lifestyles through social media

Do you love creating content, spotting social media trends, and engaging with online communities?

We're looking for a creative and enthusiastic Social Media Assistant to help bring the Berzerk Active Play brand to life across TikTok and Instagram. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys creating engaging content, keeping up with trends, and helping grow a brand's online presence.

Whether you're studying, looking for additional hours, building a career in marketing, or simply passionate about social media, we'd love to hear from you.

About Trilogy Active

At Trilogy Active, our mission is simple:

Inspiring Active Lifestyles

We are a charity and social enterprise dedicated to improving the wellbeing of people across our communities through sport, physical activity, health and wellbeing opportunities.

Everything we do is guided by our values:
- One Trilogy Team
- Encourage Creativity
- Be Constructive
- Deliver Excellence
- Promote Wellbeing
- Embrace Diversity

What you'll be doing

As our Social Media Assistant, you'll support the growth of Berzerk Active Play's online presence by:
- Creating engaging content for TikTok and Instagram
- Identifying and responding to current social media trends
- Supporting the delivery of the social media content plan
- Monitoring and responding to comments and messages across social media channels
- Attending monthly planning meetings with the Marketing Communications Officer
- Producing simple monthly reports on social media performance, engagement and reach
- Helping generate new ideas to grow our audience and increase engagement

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is:
- Passionate about social media and content creation
- Creative with an eye for detail
- Confident using TikTok and Instagram
- Enthusiastic, motivated and proactive
- Comfortable communicating with people online
- Open to learning and trying new ideas
- A positive team player who enjoys working with others
- Flexible and willing to travel between Trilogy Active and Berzerk Active Play sites when required

Why join us?

At Trilogy Active you'll be part of an organisation that genuinely cares about people, wellbeing and community impact. You'll have the opportunity to develop your social media and marketing skills while helping inspire more people to get active and have fun.

If you're creative, full of ideas and excited by the power of social media, we'd love to hear from you.

Join us and help inspire active lifestyles.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Northampton
